study_identification_part.si4_title: Resting-State Changes in Aging and Parkinson's Disease Are Shaped by Underlying Neurotransmission: A Normative Modeling Study

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Objectives are explicitly stated in the abstract and introduction: to test how age- and Parkinson's disease-related resting-state changes (fALFF, LCOR, GCOR) colocalize with neurotransmitter systems using UK Biobank; and to use normative modeling to assess deviations in PD. The purpose of applying normative modeling is to characterize individual-level deviations from typical aging trajectories and relate them to clinical relevance.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: METHODS: Making use of recent developments in normative modeling... we tested in the UK Biobank cohort (n = 25,917) whether and how age- and Parkinson's disease–related resting-state changes ... colocalize with underlying neurotransmitter systems. ... Combining normative modeling and neurotransmitter mapping may aid future research and drug development...
cm1_research_objectives.location: Kasper2024.pdf.md: Abstract (lines ~11–15); Introduction (normative models rationale, lines ~33–35)

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The reference cohort consisted of UK Biobank adults without psychiatric, cognitive, or neurological disorders per ICD-10-based exclusions (Table S1). nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: We included 25,917 adult participants from the UK Biobank not diagnosed with psychiatric, cognitive, or neurological disorders (Table S1)... nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing software and steps are detailed: UK Biobank initial pipeline, followed by SPM12, FSL v5.0, and CONN toolbox in MATLAB 2020b; steps include normalization to MNI, resampling, smoothing, bandpass filtering, nuisance regression, and QC thresholds.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: Initial preprocessing performed by the UK Biobank team consisted of ... ICA+FIX. ... Further processing was conducted with SPM12, FSL v5.0, and the CONN toolbox implemented in MATLAB (v2020b). ... After resampling (3 mm^3) and smoothing (4 mm FWHM) ... applied a bandpass filter (0.008–0.09 Hz) ... regressed out 24 parameters of motion, as well as the mean signal from white matter and cerebrospinal fluid ... excluded data ... (max rotation > 2° and movement > 3 mm).
